name: Milwaukee Metropolitan Sewerage District (combined sewer system, Milwaukee and Shorewood)
outfalls_source: EPA National CSO Inventory (data/outfalls-us.json): 114 open, 0 closed; MMSD CSO Public Notification Plan (2018) tables 1.2-1.8, 115 outfalls
notification_channel: Storm Update news posts with volume and the 5-day letter (about 5 days after); live year-to-date "Gallons Overflowed" counter on the rain/facility page; CSO impacted-waters ArcGIS map; Water Drop Alert SMS (pre-storm only). No same-day public overflow notice found on the web.
notes: Great Lakes Basin: 40 CFR 122.38 4-hour notice. 2025 overflow total 5,140 million gallons; 2026 to April 2,714 million gallons.

notes: Permit number for the SSO points inferred to be the same MMSD permit; not checked.
